document.title: Kaiser Permanente integrated-care model (hand-modeled)
document.note: Kaiser is an integrated payer-provider: care is coordinated through internal referrals inside the Permanente Medical Groups rather than an external prior-authorization code list. There is no published PA code list to ingest; this ruleset is hand-modeled and says so in every answer. Narrow exceptions (e.g. some self-funded/KPIC PPO products) are pending sources.

rules.note: Hand-modeled: Kaiser coordinates services through internal referrals, not an external PA list. Verify plan-specific exceptions (KPIC/self-funded PPO) with Kaiser directly.
rules.detail: No external prior authorization; access is governed by referral inside Kaiser's integrated system.
